description: This file defines the API and data structures for managing TLS credentials in a network stack, including credential types, adding, retrieving, and deleting credentials.

methods.name: tls_credential_add
methods.description: Adds a TLS credential for authentication, referencing by security tag and credential type.

methods.name: tls_credential_get
methods.description: Retrieves a registered TLS credential based on security tag and credential type.

methods.name: tls_credential_delete
methods.description: Removes a TLS credential identified by security tag and credential type.
